name: Sunway Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sunway 提出以现金加新股方式有条件自愿全面收购 IJM Corporation Berhad，最终取得约33.43%股权，未达到50%门槛；同时一家已停止运营的子公司完成成员自愿清盘。集团层面还推进了 ESOS 等公司治理事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Sunway launched a conditional voluntary take-over offer for IJM Corporation Berhad, satisfied by cash and new Sunway shares, and ultimately held approximately 33.43% of IJM, below the 50% threshold; meanwhile, a dormant subsidiary completed its member's voluntary winding up. At the group level, corporate governance matters such as an ESOS were also progressed.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面主要推进对 IJM Corporation Berhad 的有条件自愿全面收购，并完成一家 dormant 子公司的成员自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: At the group level this year, the main activity was the conditional voluntary take-over offer for IJM Corporation Berhad, along with the completion of a member's voluntary winding up of a dormant subs…

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 已停止运营并处于 dormant 状态的子公司 MCL Land (Pantai View) Sdn Bhd 完成成员自愿清盘，并于2026年11月19日向马来西亚公司委员会提交清盘人最终会议申报表。
actions.text_en: MCL Land (Pantai View) Sdn Bhd, a dormant subsidiary that had ceased business operations, completed its member's voluntary winding up, with the liquidator lodging the Returns by Liquidator Relating to Final Meeting with the Companies Commission of Malaysia on…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Sunway 对 IJM Corporation Berhad 的有条件自愿全面收购于2026年4月6日截止，171,716,556 股，约占33.43%投票权，未达到50%门槛。
actions.text_en: Sunway's conditional voluntary take-over offer for IJM Corporation Berhad closed on 6 April 2026; following valid acceptances, Sunway held 1,171,716,556 IJM shares, representing approximately 33.43% of voting shares, below the 50% threshold.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Sunway 股东在临时股东大会上批准了收购 IJM Corporation Berhad 普通股的议案。
actions.text_en: Sunway shareholders approved the ordinary resolution relating to the proposed offer to acquire ordinary shares in IJM Corporation Berhad at an EGM.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED CONDITIONAL VOLUNTARY TAKE-OVER OFFER BY SUNWAY BERHAD ("SUNWAY") THROUGH MAYBANK INVES
actions.text: Sunway 发出收购 IJM Corporation Berhad 全部普通股的要约文件，要约价为每股 RM3.15，其中10%以现金支付，90%以每股 RM5.65 的新 Sunway 普通股支付。
actions.text_en: Sunway issued the offer document to acquire all ordinary shares in IJM Corporation Berhad at an offer price of RM3.15 per offer share, satisfied by 10% in cash and 90% in new Sunway ordinary shares at an issue price of RM5.65 each.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 批准因收购要约将发行的 Sunway 对价股份上市及报价。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing of and quotation for the Sunway consideration shares to be issued pursuant to the take-over offer.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: Sunway 通过有条件自愿全面收购 IJM Corporation Berhad，未取得控制权。
model_changes.text_en: Sunway pursued a conditional voluntary take-over offer for IJM Corporation Berhad and ultimately held approximately 33.43% of its shares, without obtaining control.
